why: Johnson-Tran-Walsberg-Ye's proof that large stable fields are separably closed (a restricted case) predates the snapshot (arXiv 2009.02319, JEMS 2024), but a 2026 arXiv paper by Kaplan, Matthews, and Walsberg ('Building trees in large fields', arXiv:2607.16942) substantially simplifies and extends that argument; unclear whether it moves the case boundary or only re-proves it, and the general (non-large) conjecture remains open in both.
